answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 25779 Country: United States of America Title: My uncle passed away recently but he did'nt used to pray. Will it benefit him if I do Isal-Sawab for him? Or is it that since he did'nt used to pray so he will first have to enter Jahannum for not praying and then enter Paradise? Question: My uncle passed away recently but he did'nt used to pray. Will it benefit him if I do Isal-Sawab for him? Or is it that since he did'nt used to pray so he will first have to enter Jahannum for not praying and then enter Paradise? Answer ID: 25779 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2226/1523/H=1431) Isal-e-sawab shall benefit him, in-sha-Allah. It is hoped that he shall get maghfirah by the virtue of isal-e-sawab and dua. و ما ذالك على الله بعزيز And if something otherwise happened with him, then also his torment may be lessened due to isal-e-sawab and it is too a great benefit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
